authority: Direct human U21: avoid local storage bloat and use GitHub by completed experiment ID.
public_release: Reviewed source, complete aggregates, figures, compact exact edits, pinned-base recipes and reconstruction utilities under each experiment ID. Verify the full remote tree before local cleanup.
model_storage: Use immutable public parent references plus exact patches or deterministic copy recipes. No repeated full base checkpoints or paid LFS.
private_evidence: Raw tasks, answers, replies, activation traces, notebooks and paper stay private. Retain verified lossless local archives and the existing private Kaggle records. The public GitHub repository is not a raw-data backup.
active_lineage: Keep every file required by active frozen hash contracts. Compress or move a referenced file only after closure, with exact original/archive hashes and a documented restore path. Never rerun a closed scorer to recover a receipt.
cleanup: Remove generated Python caches, temporary rendered pages and verified redundant downloads after provenance is retained. Do not delete unique scientific evidence.
current_observation_budget: N38 scientific outputs are prospectively bounded to 64 MiB. Full activation tensors and full model weights are never saved as experiment output.
